title: Honeyed Hot Mediterranean White Fish En-Croute
description: A sweet and savory Mediterranean dish featuring white fish, en-croute, with a malty and cheesy flavor profile. This recipe is perfect for a dinner party or special occasion.
instructions: Thaw the puff pastry sheet according to the package instructions.
Cut the white fish fillets into 4 equal pieces.
In a small bowl, mix together honey, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the fish pieces.
Place the fish pieces on one half of the puff pastry sheet, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle crumbled feta cheese over the fish pieces.
Fold the other half of the puff pastry sheet over the fish and press the edges to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
Place the en-croute on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the fish is cooked through.
Remove the en-croute from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Let the en-croute rest for 5 minutes before serving.
